Kitchen Products > Tidewell Enameled Dutch Oven (5.5 qt)

The Dutch Oven is enameled cast iron and weighs 12.4 lb. It comes in three colors: Sea Glass, Oat and Charcoal. It is oven safe to 500°F (260°C). question: What kind of stove tops can I use this Dutch Oven on?
